+def _completed_prior_counters(prior, phase):
+    """Necessary completed-history consistency, never a proof of historical execution."""
+    exposure = prior['exposure']
+    members, decompressions, utf8, xml = (exposure[name + '_completed'] for name in
+        ('member_opens', 'decompressions', 'utf8_decodes', 'xml_parses'))
+    if phase == 'layout':
+        core._require(members == decompressions == utf8 == xml and members >= 6,
+                      'PRIOR_RECEIPT_INVALID')
+    else:
+        shared = int(any(field['declared_type'] == 's' for field in prior['inventory']['fields']))
+        core._require(members == decompressions and members >= 6 + shared
+                      and utf8 == xml == members + 2, 'PRIOR_RECEIPT_INVALID')
+
+
+def _matching_prior_counts(layout, inventory):
+    shared = int(any(field['declared_type'] == 's' for field in inventory['inventory']['fields']))
+    return (inventory['exposure']['member_opens_completed'] ==
+            layout['exposure']['member_opens_completed'] + shared)
